description:
The female lead enjoyed playing PK games with bad manners, but in reality, she had good friends, studies well, and was polite to adults. Reality can be tough at times and she relieves her stress through games. One day, she awakes in the world of the game she was playing due to an accident and becomes Hong Yeomhui, a girl in a mundane family with a weak body made possible through conspiracies despite having the strongest constitution in the game.

Not desiring to live in confinement, Hong Yeomhui decides to change her fate using her in-game experience to return to her original world. In the process, she meets the world’s most beautiful men.

Will Hong Yeomhui be able to solve the mystery of the game and return home?
